title: US digital rights group Holistic Resilience launched Mahsa Alert to provide Iranians with offline mapping and strike notifications, hitting 100K DAUs in days (Wired)
summary: Wired: US digital rights group Holistic Resilience launched Mahsa Alert to provide Iranians with offline mapping and strike notifications, hitting 100K DAUs in days — The crowdsourced website and app Mahsa Alert provides citizens in Iran with crucial information amid the country's ongoing war …
